users_contact_present.name: users_contact_present
users_contact_present.value: "users"."phone" is not null or "users"."email" is not null

vendor_bank_accounts_primary_key.name: vendor_bank_accounts_primary_key
vendor_bank_accounts_primary_key.where: is_primary = true and deleted_at is null

product_variants_default_key.name: product_variants_default_key
product_variants_default_key.where: is_default = true and deleted_at is null

addresses_default_key.name: addresses_default_key
addresses_default_key.where: is_default = true and deleted_at is null

banners_placement_idx.name: banners_placement_idx
banners_placement_idx.where: is_active = true and deleted_at is null

carts_owner_present.name: carts_owner_present
carts_owner_present.value: "carts"."user_id" is not null or "carts"."guest_token" is not null

orders_cod_amount_consistent.name: orders_cod_amount_consistent
orders_cod_amount_consistent.value:
("orders"."is_cod" = false and "orders"."cod_amount_paise" is null)
          or ("orders"."is_cod" = true and "orders"."cod_amount_paise" is not null)

deliveries_cod_variance_idx.name: deliveries_cod_variance_idx
deliveries_cod_variance_idx.where: cod_variance_paise is not null and cod_variance_paise <> 0

drivers_dispatch_idx.name: drivers_dispatch_idx
drivers_dispatch_idx.where: availability = 'ONLINE' and status = 'APPROVED' and current_latitude is not null
